notes: A full AF_UNIX backlog refuses immediately on both platforms. Live proof records the 1,000 ms setting and bounded refusal; socket-double unit proof covers timer expiry.

Real macOS abort is close-only (EOF wins); Linux emits error-before-close with os error 104 and late replay. Error-before-close and late error are boundary-double proof injected into the selected worker stdin, not the supervisor.
